shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Per-band biomes now resolve through vanilla's own per-cell BiomeAt API; sky plateaus generate real vegetation, basements can be carved as Biomes! Caverns caves, and the vanishing-colonist generation bug is root-caused and fixed.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED** (156 files / 40,713 LOC). Current tree: **50 files / ~9,900 LOC**.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`, so the column behaves as one big map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. THE ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**, each a contiguous `CellIndices` range. `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. An impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** separates bands. Typical live layout: `200×768`, bandCount 3, bandHeight 200, slot 256, gutter 56, surfaceBand 1.

**`Slot` is rounded up to a multiple of 64.** Load-bearing: terrain shaders sample from WORLD POSITION, so a non-aligned offset makes identical terrain render with a different texture phase in the see-below view.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Two spatially distant regions sharing a `RegionLink` are adjacent as far as RimWorld is concerned. Both ends are `RegionType.Portal` (the stair subclasses `Building_Door`), and `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom`, so the link **conducts connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**. `Reachability.CanReach` is managed region-BFS, so it works unpatched — transitively fixing `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search and **every `WorkGiver_Scanner`**.

**Verified in play:** colonists cross bands for `HaulToContainer`, `HaulToCell`, `Ingest`, `Clean`, `BuildRoof`, `FinishFrame`, `LayDown`, `SocialRelax` — with no hauling code written.

### ⚠ Portal regions are ONE CELL — the multi-cell rule
`RegionTypeUtility.IsOneCellRegion(Portal)` is **true**: every door cell is its own Portal region. A 2×2 stairwell is therefore **4 Portal regions per end**, and a wormhole must link **every cell pair**, not just the building's `Position`. Linking one pair leaves the rest of the footprint conducting nothing, and which cell a pawn walks into decides whether the stairs work — the classic "works sometimes" symptom. `ABWormhole.Pair` holds `List<RegionLink>`; `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M cells` with a `<-- PARTIAL` warning.

Also note `AllowsMultipleRegionsPerDistrict(Portal)` is **false**, and vanilla's largest door is 2×1 (Ornate Door). Our 3×3 grand staircase = 9 Portal regions is **beyond anything vanilla ships** — untested territory, watch the `N/M` line.

### The dividing line
| Class | Outcome |
|---|---|
| **Graph / logic** — reachability, storage, work scanning, hauling, needs, reservations | **FREE** |
| **Geometry / presentation** — LOS, range, targeting, path lines, ghosts, projectiles, labels, selection | **NOT free.** Every 2D-cell-space computation must be told |

Fix each geometry surface **at its own draw/compute site**. Never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally — the see-below renderer prints below things at real positions then translates emitted vertices, so a pre-localized DrawPos double-shifts. (That was V1's `DrawPosOffsetPatcher`.)

### A third category: reachability-as-proxy
Some vanilla code uses `CanReach` to mean *"is this a sensible place"* rather than *"can I get there"*. Confirmed: `WanderUtility.GetColonyWanderRoot` — idle pawns **commuted across bands to stand somewhere**. Fixed by clamping the root to the pawn's band. **Un-audited siblings:** joy/recreation spot choice, meditation focus, animal grazing/pen logic.

### Hard 1.6 constraints
- Pathfinder is **jobified**. A* neighbour expansion is **not patchable**. Custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`.
- `PathFinder` has **no `FindPath`** — managed surface is `FindPathNow` + `PathFinderTick`.
- `PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on **unwalkable** cells (doors are NOT special-cased). Sky bands are full of impassable `AB_OpenAir`, so diagonal-only links are a real hazard.

### ⚠ Map components are UNSET during generation
`ABBandMap.Setup` runs in the `GenerateMap` postfix, so for the whole of map generation `bands.Banded` is **false** and every band helper answers as if the map were ordinary. Anything that must be band-correct *during* generation reads `ABBandedGeneration.TryPendingSurfaceRect` instead. This is a standing trap for any future genstep work.

---

# 2. PER-BAND BIOME — SOLVED (2026-07-28)

Logged for months as V2's *one genuine regression vs V1*. Closed.

**The problem.** V1 gave each level a real `BiomeDef` free (`pocketTileInfo.PrimaryBiome`, deep-scribed by vanilla). V2 has one `Map`; `Map.Biome` is get-only and derived from the world tile. The old plan was to feed each consumer explicitly, one bespoke patch at a time.

**The discovery that replaced that plan.** RimWorld 1.6 ships a genuinely **per-cell biome API** for Odyssey's mixed-biome maps: `map.BiomeAt(cell)` → `MixedBiomeMapComponent.GetBiomeAt(cell)`. Vanilla routes its own biome-scoped systems through it:
- `WildPlantSpawner` — **9 call sites**: plant CHOICE (`AllWildPlants`, `wildPlants`), density, regrow days, cave-plant commonality
- `WildAnimalSpawner` — **5**: animal choice, commonality, scaria chance
- `MapGenUtility` — **10**: water / beach / mud / riverbank terrain

`Patch_MixedBiome_ABBandBiomeAt` prefixes that one choke point and answers from `ABBandEnv.BiomeOf`.

**Why this is NOT the rejected pattern.** What was ruled out was a contextual `map.Biome` *getter* driven by an ambient "current cell" latch — lying to vanilla behind a global. `GetBiomeAt` takes the cell as a **parameter**; answering it from the cell handed in has no ambient state, no latch, no ordering hazard.

**Scope guard:** the prefix only claims cells whose level is non-zero. The surface band stays vanilla, so Odyssey's real mixed-biome grid is untouched where it means anything.

**A patch was DELETED, not added.** `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABBandDensity` had to go, and keeping it would have caused two bugs:
1. **Double counting.** `GetBaseDesiredPlantsCountAt` is **fertility only**. Vanilla applies biome density *separately* in `CalculateDesiredPlants` as `map.BiomeAt(forCell).plantDensity * …`. Scaling both squares the factor.
2. **The basement hard-zero** blocked cavern support outright — flora would seed at gen and never regrow. Plain rock still yields nothing anyway: rough stone has zero fertility, and `AB_Underground` has `plantDensity 0`.

---

# 3. SKY VEGETATION

Two independent bugs, both fixed:
1. **`ABSkyBandGen` spawned zero plants** — terrain only, so a new summit was bare soil and gravel. Added `SeedFlora`, a staggered-growth pass over classified plateau cells.
2. **`AB_OpenSky`'s curated `wildPlants` list was dead code** — `skyBiomeInherit = true` meant `BiomeOf` returned `map.Biome` and never read it, despite the XML comment claiming it drove plateau regrowth.

**Design decision (user): the sky biome is LOCKED to the surface biome.** No species filter built — vanilla's per-cell `fertilityMin` gate already keeps lowland/water species off plateau soil and gravel, and open air / roof surfaces are never plateau cells. `AB_OpenSky` survives only as the opt-out path. Setting: `skyVegetationDensity` (0–2×).

---

# 4. BIOMES! CAVERNS BASEMENTS (re-added from V1)

`BiomesCavernsCompat` ported **verbatim** — it never had a pocket-map dependency. `ABCavernGen` ports V1's `GenStep_ABCavernCarve`: worm-carved connected network, chambers, biome-authentic floors (patch makers → fertility bands), support pillars, starting flora + fauna.

**Three things had to change for V2 — NOT a copy-paste:**
1. **Band scoping.** V1 carved `CellRect.WholeMap(map)` because the basement *was* the map. Here that tunnels through the colony and the sky.
2. **The biome.** `pocketTileInfo.PrimaryBiome` has no per-band equivalent → scribed `ABBandMap.basementBiome`. Without scribing, a reload silently reverts to rock and quietly changes regrowth/wildlife.
3. **Foreign gensteps.** BC's scatterers pick cells **map-wide** and can't be scoped from outside. `RunForeignGenStep` snapshots `listerThings.AllThings`, runs it, then destroys strays outside the band.

**Earthen Depths:** V1 kept it rare (15) because a pocket map takes temperature from the biome constant (~55 °C). V2's basement is roofed rock under vanilla *room* temperature, so it's at a fair 40/30/30 **pending play test**; `WeightOf` is the knob if a carved cavern still reads as an oven.

Settings render only when Biomes! Caverns is loaded, so no dead sliders imply absent capability.

---

# 5. VANISHING COLONISTS — ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED (2026-07-28)

Was listed as "unconfirmed". Confirmed, understood, fixed.

**The bug.** `ScenPart_PlayerPawnsArriveMethod` spawns the colony from **`GenerateIntoMap`**, driven by the `ScenParts` GenStep — i.e. *during* generation. Vanilla order is `FindPlayerStartSpot` (40) → `ScenParts` (41) → `Fog` (48). The old `FixPlayerStartSpot` ran in the `GenerateMap` **postfix**, on an explicit code comment asserting "scenario pawns spawn AFTER generation" — which is false (`PostMapGenerate` only grants the `CrashedTogether` thought). Real sequence:

1. `FindPlayerStartSpot` picks a cell anywhere in the **whole inflated map**.
2. `ScenParts` drops the colonists on it.
3. Our postfix carves the non-surface bands — `ClearCellHard`/`FillRock` call `Destroy(DestroyMode.Vanish)` on everything there.
4. Our postfix *then* moved the start spot — long after the pawns were gone.

**Why intermittent:** `CellFinderLoose.TryFindCentralCell` starts at the map centre, which for a 3-band map with `surfaceBand 1` happens to sit inside the surface band most of the time. Only when the central cells fail the validator and the search wanders into the gutter or another band is the colony deleted — silently, since nothing went wrong from vanilla's view.

**The fix, two layers:**
- **Root cause** — `Patch_GenStep_FindPlayerStartSpot_ABSurfaceBand` postfixes `GenStep_FindPlayerStartSpot.Generate` and clamps the spot into the surface band *before* anything consumes it. Also fixes `GenStep_Fog`'s unfog root and `GenStep_Scatterer`'s fallback for free. Keeps a **24-cell margin** from the band's z edges because `DropCellFinder` scatters pods well away from the requested centre.
- **Safety net** — `RescueStrandedColonists` runs immediately before `Carve` and **moves** (never destroys) any player-faction pawn found outside the surface band, logging a `Log.Warning`. Covers drop-pod scatter, gravship starts and modded ScenParts. Moving matters: a starting colonist is fully generated with relations, possessions and a scenario role, so losing one is unrecoverable.

Band-stride gotcha hit while writing this: the in-band offset must be taken modulo **`Slot`** (height + gutter), not band height — modulo height skews the row by a growing multiple of the gutter.

---

# 6. MEASURED PERFORMANCE

| Stage | Total mod cost / 2000 frames |
|---|---|
| Baseline | **3,791 ms** (58 patches) |
| After overlay + re-arm gate + V1 delete | **740.9 ms** (22 patches) |
| After event re-arm + lighting bake | **122.4 ms** |
| Same build, 17 colonists | **215.8 ms** — fps 59.2, f95 16.69 ms |

1. `OverlayDrawer.DrawAllOverlays` postfix: **1.406 → 0.0018 ms/frame**.
2. Wormhole re-arm: **0.339 ms/frame → 0, and no longer a patch.** Gating a hot method with a prefix recovered only 22% because the gate *added a second patch to a very hot method*. Now event-driven off `MapEvents.RegionsRoomsChanged`.
3. Vanilla `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay` bake: **25 calls → 0.** Suppressing `Visible` stops the DRAW but not the BAKE.
4. **V1 deleted** — never inert, only idle; its patches stayed live on hot getters.

Measured **not** a problem: `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2.Regenerate` ≈ **0.9 µs/call**.

### ⚠ Unmeasured: `GetBiomeAt`
The new prefix sits on a method called **per cell** inside `WildPlantSpawner`'s scan loops. Mitigated with a one-entry map→comp memo, but **not yet measured** — first thing to profile next MDS run.

### Pathfinding — answered
| Scenario | Banded | Vanilla ctl | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ai.pathfind` | **556.6 µs** | 944.6 µs | **0.59×** |
| `ai.reachability` | 1.152 µs | 0.393 µs | 2.9× |
| `world.regions` | 0.339 µs | 0.071 µs | 4.8× |

**No per-path regression.** The real tax is reachability and region lookup, ~3× the regions/cells.

---

# 7. LESSONS THAT COST REAL TIME

1. **Classify by BEHAVIOUR, not directory.** `SectionLayer_ABMountainCap` lived in V1's folder but is live V2 code. **`Section` instantiates every `SectionLayer` subclass reflectively — deleting one is invisible to the compiler; a green build proves nothing.**
2. **A benchmark that surprises you is usually broken.** Sample **outside** the stopwatch; divide by **effective** iterations.
3. **Nested instrumentation inflates outer timings.** Never compare absolutes across differently-armed runs.
4. **`PawnRenderer.GetBodyPos` discards `drawLoc`** for a humanlike in a bed.
5. **`RenderPawnAt` only self-heals when `!results.valid`.** Run all three `DynamicDrawPhaseAt` phases.
6. **A malformed `About.xml` silently DROPS a mod.**
7. **Never mutate a collection you're enumerating from a callback.**
8. **Diagnostics that omit the discriminating field cost cycles.**
9. **Look for a vanilla API before building a workaround.** The per-band biome regression stood as "V2's one genuine loss" while `map.BiomeAt(cell)` existed the whole time. Found by grepping the *consumer* (`WildPlantSpawner`), not the concept (`Map.Biome`). **Grep how vanilla CONSUMES a thing, not how it stores it.**
10. **Distrust confident comments about ordering.** The vanishing-colonist bug survived because a comment stated pawns spawn after generation. The comment was wrong, read as authoritative, and cost a whole bug cycle. **Verify ordering claims against the genstep list.**
11. Misc: `menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef · geysers are `destroyable=false` · `GenStep_Fog` fogs the whole map · `GenRadial` caps at ~79.8 · `MapDrawLayer.map` is private · emit ONE self-contained log message per event.

**PROCESS: measure, don't reason.**

---

# 8. DIAGNOSTICS
`AB2: band info` · `AB2: transit health` · `AB2: below pawn report` · `AB2: why is this pawn stuck` · **`ABStuckWatchdog`** · `AB2: toggle transit logging` · `AB2: below layer report` · `AB2: lighting report` · bisect toggles · `AB2: spike - build wormhole chamber` · **`AB2: biome report`** (NEW — per band, round-trips the REAL `map.BiomeAt()` against `BiomeOf()` and prints `<-- MISMATCH, patch NOT applied` if they disagree; plus plant/animal census and mean fertility).

# 9. OPEN WORK

### Untested (this session's work — all green, none run)
Per-band biome · sky flora · cavern basements · colonist-spawn fix. First test must confirm: `AB2: biome report` shows `[patch live]` on all three bands · summit visibly vegetated · basement carved with BC flora · **no stalagmites on the surface band** · Earthen Depths survivable · colonists land on the surface every time · no "rescued N player pawn(s)" warning (if it appears, the upstream clamp is leaking).

### Bugs
- **Transient stall near stairwells.** Watchdog verdict **BLOCKED**, self-resolves. It now reports `nextCell` occupant/door state — **read that line next.**
- **COMBAT — status was STALE in the old handoff.** Not untouched: **575 LOC / 3 files** implement shootline, body facing, gun-sprite aim, `ShotReport` distance localization, cross-band acquisition, projectile-origin translation. Correct status: **implemented, never verified in play.** (a) projectiles below still never drawn (`ABBelowDynamicDraw` iterates pawns only) — CONFIRMED; (b) "will still miss" likely obsolete, since the origin patch moves the projectile into the target's band. **Untested interaction:** downward shots need below-draw to be visible, while **upward shots draw in the band above and the see-below renderer only looks down** — invisible even after fixing (a).

### Deferred
- **Elevator (3-level shaft).** Needs TWO counterparts on one building. (`AB_Elevator.png` exists, unreferenced.)
- **Transplant** — fixes the coastline caveat (**inland tiles for now**), save migration, true-lazy banding.
- Turret cross-band targeting · drafted move ghost · sky richness · Alpha Biomes carve types (V1 supported mycotic jungle / gelatinous superorganism / forsaken crags / tar pits; Alpha Biomes is installed).

### Perf backlog
**Profile `GetBiomeAt`** · map gen ~3× slower (cavern carve adds to it) · isolate `PathGridJob` rebuild · compat audit not started.

---

# 10. VERTICAL LINKS

| Def | Footprint | Cardinal approaches |
|---|---|---|
| `AB2_LadderDown/Up` | 1×1 | 4 |
| `AB2_StairsDown/Up` | 2×2 | 8 |
| `AB2_GrandStairsDown/Up` | 3×3 | 12 |

Transit is a **teleport** (`Carry`) — "grand" buys approaches, not speed. All inherit `AB2_LinkBase`, which overrides `blueprintClass` to `Blueprint_Build`; **without that override every link renders as a generic door while placing.** `ArriveRadius = LandingRadius + 1`, tied deliberately.

# 11. PUBLISHING STATE

**⚠ CORRECTION — the old handoff said `PublishedFileId.txt` was deleted. It is back**, containing **`3773267907`** (written 2026-07-28 08:33). V1's id was `3767572810`, so "disconnected from the original" held — but **this mod is already a live Workshop item.**

That promotes the description problem to a **live store page making false claims**: `About.xml`'s `<description>` is still V1's and promises elevators, vertical conduit/water/duct/chem shafts, psycast cross-level targeting, caravans, Hospitality guest tours, trader airships, "zero recurring cost until you build a level". User-owned text — rewrite offered, not yet accepted.

Also stale: `About/known-issues.json` (V1's, 18 entries) · `ARCHITECTURE.md` (banner-marked V1-DELETED) · `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` · `docs/V2-HANDOFF.md` (predates sections 2–5 above).

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true` always. Companions **`astryl.ModernDevSuite` + `astryl.ModernDevTools`**, plus **`BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns`** (+ `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework`) for cavern work. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **Banding happens at generation ⇒ needs a NEW colony.** Map gen ~3× slower — expected. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands.** Transit logging and the stuck watchdog reset every launch.
